title: Grain Desk Standing Rule: How a Member's Marketing Average Is Taken
content:
How the marketing average behind a contract under Grain Marketing Contracts is taken depends on how recent the member's marketing business is, as the equity ledger held under Membership and Patronage Equity records it.

**1.** Where the equity ledger records grain business inside the last twelve months and the equity account stands active, the average is the last twenty-four months of marketed bushels divided by the recent history window of 2 crop years, since a member trading now is measured on the years they have just traded.

**2.** Where the ledger records grain business inside the last twelve months but no active equity account stands, the average is the bushels marketed in those twelve months taken as they stand, undivided.

**3.** Where the ledger records no grain business inside the last twelve months, the average is the last thirty-six months of marketed bushels divided by the production history window the marketing programme carries.

## The three cases in one view

| Grain business recorded inside the last twelve months | Equity account standing | Marketing average taken as |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | active | the last twenty-four months of marketed bushels divided by 2 |
| Yes | not active | the bushels marketed in the last twelve months, as they stand |
| No | active | the last thirty-six months of marketed bushels divided by the production history window the marketing programme carries |
| No | not active | the last thirty-six months of marketed bushels divided by the production history window the marketing programme carries |

## Illustration on hypothetical records

The equity ledger shows 44,000 bushels of grain business over the last twelve months, 96,000 over the last twenty-four and 150,000 over the last thirty-six, and the equity account stands active. The average is 48,000 bushels. Were the account not active, it would be the 44,000 bushels of the last twelve months. Were there no business at all inside the last twelve months, the 150,000 bushels of the last thirty-six would be divided by the window the marketing programme carries.
